items.html:
(to the question) The Mochin of a child of four years
The Mochin of a child of four years are: the inner and surrounding ones of Ima of Katnut, which are the Katnut of the five Gevurot along with the Gadlut of the five Gevurot; and likewise the phase of the NH of the inner ones of Aba of Katnut, where the Netzah of the five Hassadim of Aba is clothed in the Hochma of ZA, and the Hod of the five Hassadim is clothed in the Bina of ZA, and the vessel of Daat is still empty of light. (Part 1, Page 166, Item 123).
